Description

Looking to hire a 5-a-side football pitch in west London? Trailfinders Sports Club has the perfect facilities for lovers of the small-sided version of the beautiful game. 5-a-side football at Trailfinders Sports Club is played on 3G astroturf. So whether you're looking for a casual kick about with your friends or whether you're part of a team that is a cohesive 5-a-side football machine, Trailfinders Sports Club is the right choice for you. The 3G pitch at the venue also facilitiates 7-a-side football on the 3G astroturf pitch.

The venue is surrounded by floodlights which makes this facility perfect all year around. The lights will be turned off by the facility once all sports bookings have been completed.

Those driving are able to park free of charge at the facility. If you’re travelling by car, then you’ll be glad to know there is ample free parking provided by the venue so finding a space should never be an issue.

The venue is open to the public to come and play on a one off basis. Their pay as you play system means that you can book now and play without being a member. This gives you the freedom to play a one off game without having to pay a monthly membership fee.

If a one-off game isn't enough, then why not take advantage of the block booking option at Trailfinders Sports Club? Block bookings are a great way to guarantee a weekly game and socialise with your friends. It also takes the hassle out of paying before each game and collecting money from teammates as there is a one-time payment.

There are smart and spacious changing rooms available for customers, with well-maintained facilities. This means customers can come straight from work or head out straight after.

The venue is situated near Castle Bar Park station. From there it is a short walk to the facility which works out well for a gentle warm down after your booking. Alternatively the venue is well served by local bus routes and is a short stroll from the bus stops at Scotch Common.
